challenges.title: Handling an angry customer over a defective product
challenges.shortDescription: De-escalate an upset shopper demanding an immediate refund for a damaged item.
challenges.mission: Listen calmly, acknowledge the customer's frustration, inspect the product or receipt, and offer a valid store policy resolution.

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting a quick refund or replacement without hassle

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Expresses strong anger about the defective product.
unacceptablePromises: Do not promise cash refund without receipt if policy forbids it.
